description: Use when you need a US public company's SEC EDGAR filings and key financials by ticker or CIK: latest filings (form, filing and report dates, accession, primary document URL; filter by form such as 10. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /sec/filings, $0.008 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193 (send this or ticker)

form.description: optional comma list of form types to keep, e.g. 10-K,10-Q,8-K

ticker.description: stock ticker, e.g. AAPL or BRK.B (send this or cik)

name: sec_filings
